flipToBack.timing: Either: event trigger (Bunker blown-away last step, any phase) OR table-changed poll restricted to the objective owner's move phase
flipToBack.prose: Flip if Bunker is 'blown away', or if during your move phase you control three exterior Endor sites each of which has two of your Rebel scouts (coded as: site is sameSiteAs a your-Rebel-scout that is 'with' another your-Rebel-scout).

children.req: CONTROL (count 3, spotting includes excluded-from-battle) of exterior Endor sites having two of your Rebel scouts together
children.filter: Filters.and(Filters.exterior_Endor_site, Filters.sameSiteAs(self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(yourRebelScout, Filters.with(self, yourRebelScout)))) where yourRebelScout = Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Rebel_scout)

flipToFront.timing: Table-changed poll restricted to the OPPONENT's move phase; suppressed permanently once Bunker has been blown away
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if (Bunker not blown away) and during opponent's move phase opponent controls the Endor system, or controls three exterior Endor sites.

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back control route is CONTROL (GameConditions.controls), not occupy, of 3 exterior Endor sites; each qualifying site must additionally contain two of your Rebel scouts together ('with' semantics: a your-Rebel-scout accompanied by another your-Rebel-scout at that site). Spotting includes cards excluded from battle.
Flip-to-back control route only fires during YOUR move phase; the Bunker blow-away route is a last-step event trigger with no phase restriction.

Flip-to-front routes are opponent CONTROL checks (Endor system, count 1; or exterior Endor sites, count 3), only during OPPONENT's move phase, and permanently disabled once Bunker has been blown away (state check GameConditions.isBlownAway, not last-step).

Both sides: place out of play on Endor system blown away, event-typed via isBlownAwayLastStep with Filters.and(CardSubtype.SYSTEM, Filters.title(Title.Endor, true)) (front Card8_078.java:129-138, back Card8_078_BACK.java:106-115).
typedIdentities: Filters.title(Title.Bunker, true) (flip route target; also flip-back suppressor via isBlownAway)
Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Rebel_scout) (the 'two Rebel scouts at each' actor filter)
Filters.Endor_system (setup deploy; opponent flip-back target; blown-away = out of play, typed Filters.and(CardSubtype.SYSTEM, Filters.title(Title.Endor, true)))

Back: Filters.and(Filters.Endor_site, Filters.sameSiteAs(self, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Rebel_scout))) (drain protection sites), Filters.Rebel_scout with Filters.abilityLessThan(3) (retrieval target), ImmuneToAttritionLessThanModifier(Filters.Rebel_scout, 4)
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game (required, from Reserve Deck): Endor system (Card8_078.java:55), Rebel Landing Site (Card8_078.java:62).

FRONT: once during each of your deploy phases, use 2 Force to take one Bunker or Deactivate The Shield Generator into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (Card8_078.java:85-101, GameTextActionId.REBEL_STRIKE_TEAM__UPLOAD_BUNKER_OR_DEACTIVATE_THE_SHIELD_GENERATOR).
BACK: once during each of your draw phases, retrieve one Rebel scout of ability < 3 (Card8_078_BACK.java:66-77).
otherObligations: FRONT: opponent loses no more than 1 Force from your Force drains at Endor locations (LimitForceLossFromForceDrainModifier, Card8_078.java:76) - your own drains are weak until flipped.

BACK: at each Endor site where you have a Rebel scout, your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent (Card8_078_BACK.java:53-57); Rebel scouts immune to attrition < 4 (58); your Epic Event destiny draws +2 (59).
BOTH SIDES: Endor system blown away places objective out of play (hard loss of objective).
Strategic note from code: flip-back requires opponent control during OPPONENT move phase only, and blowing away the Bunker locks the objective on the back side permanently.
